purpose: Post-failure localization of fixed existing AMI published-reference errors. No inference, retuning, reference replacement or fresh heldout/release qualification.
mapping_rule: One optimal reference-to-system speaker map per full 120-second UEM/profile/backend/channel from the pinned official continuous scorer; retain it for every bin. No per-bin remapping.

reference_span.silence: No active input reference RTTM span
reference_span.short_only: Only clipped input reference spans of duration <=1 second active
reference_span.long_only: Only clipped input reference spans of duration >1 second active
reference_span.mixed: Both short and long input reference spans active

limitations: Already-seen 120-second cold-start crops; no new untouched-heldout validation or full meeting/model-card reproduction.

Input clipped RTTM span length defines timeline strata; these are collective reference-occupancy bins, not causal attribution to individual replies. Crop-edge spans retain clipping. No span merging, label-driven hypothesis filtering, threshold/context tuning or changed original gate.
FP32 is the already executed official HF/PyTorch CPU run, repeated for both backend comparisons; native Q8 outputs are existing CPU/Metal results.
Published lexical references are diagnostic only. Frozen transcription-reference failures and all release gates remain unchanged.
